name: SDN-AP Propagator
description: General-perturbations propagation of whole catalogs in one WASM module. Theories: SGP4 (STR#3 / Vallado 2006) and SGP4XP (the US Space Force SGP4-XP theory, clean-room from the public change list and the black-box specification). Propagator ABI exports (plugin_init_omm, plugin_propagate, plugin_propagate_batch, plugin_entity_count, plugin_destroy; Earth-fixed meters) and a structure-of-arrays batch entry (sdnap_*; TEME or Earth-fixed). Bounded memory per object, fixed at ingest; any time costs at most one checkpoint interval of integration, and results do not depend on the order times are requested in.

methods.description: Adopts mean elements from SDS $OMM records (MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY SGP4 or SGP4XP; for SGP4XP, BTERM in BSTAR and AGOM in MEAN_MOTION_DDOT, both m^2/kg) and replaces the module's element set. Propagation is reached through the propagator ABI exports and the sdnap_* batch entry, not through this invoke surface.

methods.description: Each $OMM (MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY SGP4XP or SGP4), plain or size-prefixed, to one $OEM, km and km/s, UTC, on the grid of an optional 'grid' $OEM: per grid block either explicit EPOCHs or START_TIME / STOP_TIME / STEP_SIZE (defaults: the set's epoch, one day later, 60 s), in the block's axes (TEME by default; GCRF or EME2000), one $OEM block per grid block; the grid's span decides how far a set runs, at most 500,000 states per request. Refused by name: missing-omm, unsupported-center, invalid-omm, invalid-grid, bad-grid, too-many-states, element-set-refused, propagation-failed (naming the time), frame-failed.

methods.description: SPEC 14: replaces the resident epoch store with the snapshot on 'omm' under the $PCF EPOCH_STORE table: per series (NORAD_CAT_ID, OBJECT_ID, theory, ORIGINATOR) the sets of the last CACHE_DAYS before the newest epoch of the load, at most MAX_SETS_PER_OBJECT (the newest), of THEORIES; sets not centered on the Earth are counted and not stored. Read through the exports sdnap_epochs_count, _stats, _series, _select and _at (selection by SELECTION, the handover blend by BLEND_WINDOW_SECONDS and BLEND_SHAPE). Refused by name: configuration-missing, configuration-refused, invalid-omm.

methods.description: SPEC 14: the epoch store of the call's own snapshot (as load_epochs builds it) on a 'grid': one $OEM per series, each state from the selected set or, inside a handover window, the blend of two (SMOOTHSTEP: r = (1 - w) r_a + w r_b, v with the weight's derivative; HERMITE: the cubic Hermite of the two sets' states at the window's edges), with the covariance mixture where the sets carry COVARIANCE. methods.description: Fits an element set to each $OEM ephemeris block; the configuration's THEORY is UNSPECIFIED or SGP4XP: the six mean elements, BTERM and AGOM of an SGP4XP set (Levenberg-Marquardt on TEME position residuals with analytic Jacobians for the elements and BTERM and a theory difference for AGOM, weak priors on BTERM and AGOM about zero), rounded to the two-line text's digits and searched on their lattice. The arc grown from two revolutions by threes to the fit interval; the interval ends at the block's USEABLE_STOP_TIME or FIT.HOLDOUT_HOURS before the data (later states held out and scored) and starts at USEABLE_START_TIME; without it the span rule (DESIGN 2e.3, $PCF FIT): FIT.DEFAULT_SPAN_HOURS (48 h; ECCENTRIC_DEFAULT_SPAN_HOURS 24 h above ECCENTRICITY_THRESHOLD 0.5), each candidate span fitted to the data before the latest TAIL_HOURS and scored on that tail, a longer one kept only when its tail error is within EXTENSION_MARGIN (0.9; eccentric 0.7) of the best shorter one's; a fit RMS beyond FIT.IMPLAUSIBLE_RMS_KM (100 km) is refused (fit-implausible). The $OMM carries MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY SGP4XP, ORIGINATOR (the $OEM's), the block OBJECT's NORAD_CAT_ID, OBJECT_ID and OBJECT_NAME, the fit and held-out statistics in its COMMENT, its COVARIANCE and USER_DEFINED_SDNAP_COV_x rows (SPEC 12); a $OBD per block carries the determination. The block's frame is read from its REFERENCE_FRAME, never assumed: TEME, GCRF or ICRF, EME2000 or J2000 and Earth-fixed (ITRF, ECEF, WGS84), time system UTC; a block centered elsewhere than the Earth is refused (unsupported-center). Plain or size-prefixed $OEM. Refused by name: configuration-missing, invalid-configuration, configuration-refused, missing-oem, invalid-oem, unsupported-center, reference-frame-undeclared, reference-frame-conflict, unsupported-frame, unsupported-time-system, too-few-states, fit-failed, fit-implausible.

inputPorts.description: $OEM ephemerides, one fit per data block (EPHEMERIS_DATA_LINES, REFERENCE_FRAME declared: TEME, GCRF, EME2000 or Earth-fixed; UTC, km).

$PCF 1.0.5 (SDS 1.271.0): THEORY and FIT (the span rule, hold-out, implausibility bound, BTERM and AGOM priors), FORCES (refused when off its defaults) and INTEGRATOR (refused); THEORY UNSPECIFIED or SGP4XP fits an SGP4XP set; fields left unset take the documented defaults, a set field this module cannot apply is refused by name (configuration-refused), the other tables are other methods'.

methods.description: DESIGN 5.1: an Earth SGP4XP $OMM across the burns of its $MNV records, in time order. Each record gives EVENT_START_TIME, the duration (EVENT_END_TIME, or TOTAL_BURN_TIME in s; none: an impulse) and DELTA_VEL_U/V/W (km/s, UVW of the pre-maneuver state: U radial, W along r x v, V = W x U). The post-maneuver set is the inverse of the output map at the burn's centroid, h^-1(x(t_b) + (0, dv), t_b), by fixed-point iteration in equinoctial elements (14); a finite burn scales the eccentricity-vector and plane changes by sinc(dL/2), dL = n D (15). Outputs: the post-maneuver $OMM of every burn (epoch the centroid; drag and SRP parameters carried), its $MNV with PRE_EVENT and POST_EVENT states (TEME, osculating elements, BALLISTIC_COEFF = 1/B_eff kg/m^2) and the CHARACTERIZATION from the dv direction, and with a 'grid' the TEME states across the burns.
